proposal.root_cause: Commit 2a17369c6d2ced90ef9c1f8de2219c887ce32290 added `nodeSelector: {disktype: ssd}` to deploy/demo/frontend.yaml, but no node in the cluster has that label, so the new frontend ReplicaSet's pods can never be scheduled.
proposal.rationale: Pod frontend-54b54c98c4-sx674 is Pending/Unschedulable: '0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector'. The only node, repair-control-plane, carries labels kubernetes.io/arch, kubernetes.io/os, kubernetes.io/hostname, node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane — no 'disktype: ssd'. Git history shows commit 2a17369c6d2ced90ef9c1f8de2219c887ce32290 ('chore(demo): update frontend.yaml', 2026-11-16T21:40:28Z) added the nodeSelector block 'disktype: ssd' to deploy/demo/frontend.yaml; the prior commit 7cd497be625a2254193984b46ae59c56a1f0e7a9 explicitly reverted exactly this nodeSelector ('fault(F25): revert nodeSelector matches no node'), and the last known good revision of the file has no nodeSelector. Other workloads in the namespace (api, redis, worker) have no nodeSelector and schedule fine. Removing the two added lines restores the last known good pod template.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the patch, the frontend Deployment rolls out a new ReplicaSet without the nodeSelector; the pending pod is replaced by a Running pod (frontend becomes ready=1/1) and no FailedScheduling events recur.
